result.summary: This PR introduces a BlockTemplateManager that centralizes mining template creation, submission, tip-waiting, and staleness state that were previously free functions requiring chainman and notifications to be threaded through every call site. It also changes waitNext to track mempool fee inflow incrementally via a new MempoolUpdated validation-interface notification and cached fee-rate-diagram chunks, instead of rebuilding a full block template on every tick under cs_main. In-process RPC and test callers now go through BlockTemplateManager directly (untracked templates) while IPC mining clients go through the tracked path, removing per-access block copies the old IPC accessors forced. About half the diff (roughly 1090 lines) is new fuzz and unit test coverage.
result.problem: Miners and pools waiting on getblocktemplate longpolls pay the cost of a full block-template rebuild under cs_main on every waitNext tick just to check whether fees rose enough to matter; internal callers also had to awkwardly thread chainman/notifications or spin up throwaway CValidationInterface subscribers just to call mining helpers.

categories.name: ipc

result.card: This PR adds a BlockTemplateManager that centralizes mining-template creation, submission, and tip-waiting state, and changes waitNext to track mempool fee inflow incrementally via a new async MempoolUpdated notification instead of rebuilding a full block template under cs_main on every tick. It solves real latency/lock-contention costs for miners and pools waiting on getblocktemplate longpolls, and its new fuzz harness already caught a real bug (#35580) where legitimate transactions were skipped due to an incorrect chunk-size check. Reviewers (pablomartin4btc, w0xlt) gave substantive Concept ACKs and Sjors's request to split the base BlockTemplateManager work was honored by opening #35675, which this PR is now stacked on and should be reviewed after. No objections are open, and the author remains active with force-pushes as recent as 2026-09-15. It also trims getblocktemplate's per-call copying and untangles internal callers from the IPC mining interface's per-access block copies.
